source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Reciprocal verbs in Sakha and the lexicon/syntax dichotomy
notes: Syntactic reciprocals cannot be discontinuous, lexical reciprocals can. The with- argument can be expressed in one of two ways : either with the help of a comitative case marker –LYYn or through a postpositional phrase involving kytta ‘with’ which assigns accusative case to its complement.
